resolution: Honored the ruling that I am blind and must PROBE with real pixels, not eyeball or reproduce in JS. Built the probe as a headless real-GPU test: it renders the actual WGSL on the iso-3D mesh path and reads the swapchain back at named cells, with a 2D /quad control proving the data is road. Used the user-supplied known-good points as a baseline to verify the probe itself is correct (centroid-fiducial fix landed here), and the user-supplied current pass/fail to confirm the verdicts match what they see on screen (6/6). The probe is the durable mechanism for all subsequent road-render verification and the fix gate.
